offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures structural connectors, fasteners, anchors and reinforcement systems for wood, steel, concrete and masonry construction. It sells through building supply distributors, dealers and home improvement retailers and provides design software and estimating services to builders and component manufacturers.

primary_products.value: structural connectors and truss plates; construction fasteners; mechanical and adhesive anchors; concrete repair and strengthening systems; structural design software

primary_services.value: material takeoffs and estimating; building information modeling

customer_segment.value: B2B: Building materials distributors, home improvement retailers, builders, contractors and prefabricated component manufacturers; B2C: Homeowners and do-it-yourself renovators

end_markets.value: residential construction and remodeling; commercial construction; industrial construction; infrastructure repair

revenue_model.value: product sales: Structural connectors, fasteners, anchors and reinforcement products; service fees: Material estimating and building modeling for homebuilders

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns steel and other materials into structural hardware sold to building suppliers and construction firms; software / platform: Turns building plans and engineering data into designs and material lists for builders and component manufacturers; service provider: Uses building plans to prepare models and material estimates for homebuilders
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Structural connectors, fastening and anchoring systems, concrete repair products, and construction design software and services

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Building materials wholesalers, lumberyards and specialty construction supply dealers; third-party retail: Home improvement chains and hardware stores; direct sales: Large construction accounts and prefabricated component manufacturers
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Structural products are subject to applicable building codes and load, seismic and fire performance standards.

notes: The pricing model for its design software is uncertain.
